articles.title: Standardized log channel is empty after mapping changes
articles.body:
Symptom: a channel streams into the source log but stays empty in the standardized log.

Cause: the standardization mapping file was changed or uploaded after the channel started streaming.

Resolution: upload the mapping file again and run a backfill for the affected channel.

articles.title: Exporting a single depth log to a WITSML store
articles.body: Open the log, choose Export, select the target WITSML store and confirm. Each depth log is exported separately; there is no bulk export today.
